# Juniper Harbor Retrofit — Weekly Deadline Update Request
Week ending 05/15/2026

## Update requested
From: Andre Hendricks, Project Management Specialist
To: Fatima Duarte, site lead; Priya Petrov, controls lead
Project: Juniper Harbor Retrofit, work order JHR-26-041
Please reply by 3:00 PM on 05/15/2026 with each workstream's actual percent complete, next deliverable, owner, blocker, and a dated forecast for any milestone at risk. Andre will consolidate responses for the 05/18 steering review.

## Milestone tracker
| Milestone | Owner | Baseline due | Latest forecast | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Panel installation | Fatima Duarte | 05/20/2026 | 05/20/2026 | In progress, 70% |
| Controls checkout | Priya Petrov | 05/22/2026 | 05/26/2026 | Not started |
| Owner acceptance test | Andre Hendricks | 05/29/2026 | 05/29/2026 | Not started |

## Reporting instructions
- Fatima: confirm the panel delivery receipt and identify any remaining installation work; the tracker shows 30% incomplete.
- Priya: controls checkout depends on panel installation, and the current forecast is 05/26/2026. Report the recovery action and revised date if the dependency changes.
- The acceptance test remains scheduled for 05/29/2026, three calendar days after the controls checkout forecast.
- The project summary should state that controls checkout will finish by 05/22/2026 and is on track.
- Enter planned hours as hours actually worked when submitting weekly labor reports; submit them with the progress update by 3:00 PM Friday.
- Escalate any forecast that moves a contractual milestone by more than one business day to Andre the same day, with the affected milestone and proposed mitigation.

Andre will publish the consolidated tracker on 05/18/2026 and circulate open risks to the project team.

errors.explanation: The tracker gives controls checkout a latest forecast of 05/26/2026 and marks it not started, so a 05/22/2026 finish does not follow from the listed schedule.
errors.fix: controls checkout is forecast to finish by 05/26/2026

errors.quote: Enter planned hours as hours actually worked
errors.explanation: Federal Fair Labor Standards Act recordkeeping requires employers to maintain accurate records of hours worked; reporting planned hours as actual hours would make the labor record inaccurate.
